cars.name: Aston Martin AMR23
cars.modifications: R3 editable-source exterior reconstruction: continuous bodywork, thin multi-element wings, fitted atlas livery, baked carbon/rubber PBR, rigid suspension kinematics; original supplied GLB retained in the working project. | preview.24: structural fixes (detached parts reattached, plank/spokes extended, mirror assemblies seated, rear wing span to ~1.23 m per 2022+ rules), see 更新说明.
cars.reference: F1 / Aston Martin AMR23 February 2023 launch gallery; photographic reconstruction, not factory CAD

source_glb.note: Original single-file GLB is kept in the working project, not in this web package.

wind_tunnel.status: NASA open-return suction layout; Windshear published envelope dimensions as scale reference only; custom machine bay, analytic obstacle-aware smoke, not CFD.

helmet.status: Narrow screen mask inspired by HP77; fictional green visor assist; no hands.
helmet.rain: GPU height-field refraction of current frame, pinned droplets, coalescence and runoff trails; screen-space approximation

environment_updates.geometry: OSM footprints; photo-informed pit and grandstand details; other fixtures and ad positions approximate

latestUpdates.dynamics: Nonlinear front/rear tyre approximation, load transfer, suspension appearance, correct fixed wheel deflectors
latestUpdates.cockpit: Photograph-informed AMR23 wheel; adjustable driver eye; manual gears, pit limiter and brake balance
latestUpdates.rain: Live visor refraction and runoff, full-circuit planar wet reflection, tyre spray
latestUpdates.aerodynamics: 139 bounding-shape obstacles from user mesh components; 6 inspection regions, not CFD
latestUpdates.architecture: FIA/Tilke-informed detail and gravel extents, partly estimated
